title: GUI Grounding for Computer-Use Agents: A Survey
why: First survey dedicated to GUI grounding: taxonomy of learning/inference/targets for screenshot-to-action localization in CUA.
mechanism: Synthesizes GUI grounding (intent→element/spatial params) along learning paradigms, inference strategies, and target representations; reviews datasets/benchmarks and compares methods for computer-use/GUI agents.
evaluation_signal: Author-reported survey: comparative analysis across ScreenSpot/ScreenSpot-Pro and related grounding benchmarks; discusses accuracy vs inference-cost trade-offs (no new agent leaderboard claimed).
